publisher: Ministry of Justice, Public Administration and Digital Transformation of the Republic of Croatia
modification_statement: Converted the original single-sheet 556-row workbook to UTF-8 CSV with the same three columns, values, and row order. No rows or labels were corrected. The CSV is retained to make the name/county/type crosswalk reproducible without an XLS reader; CRLF line endings were normalized to LF. No rows, values, labels, or row order were corrected.
